questions.stem: 在創客空間（makerspace）裡，昂貴的設備由所有會員共用，這讓人人都有機會把創意變成發明。
questions.answer: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all members, which gives everyone a chance to turn creative ideas into inventions.
accepted_answers: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all the members, which gives everybody an opportunity to turn their creativity into inventions.
In a makerspace, expensive machines and tools are shared by all members, which gives everyone a chance to turn their creative ideas into inventions.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which gives …）

questions.stem: 它們還開設免費課程，讓那些買不起工具的人也能探索興趣、學習新技能。
questions.answer: They also offer free classes, allowing those who can't afford their own tools to explore their interests and learn new skills.
accepted_answers: They also run free courses, enabling those who cannot afford tools of their own to explore their interests and pick up new skills.
They also provide free lessons, making it possible for those who cannot afford tools to explore their interests and learn new skills.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, allowing …）

1.explanation_zh: 「昂貴的設備由所有會員共用」設備是承受動作的一方，英文用被動 is shared by all members；equipment 是不可數名詞，動詞用單數 is。「這讓人人都有機會…」的「這」指前面整件事（設備共用），用非限定關係子句 , which gives everyone a chance to V。「把創意變成發明」用 turn A into B，「創意」寫成名詞 creative ideas 或 creativity。
evidence: 昂貴的設備由所有會員共用
這讓人人都有機會把創意變成發明
1.strategy_zh: 「A 由 B＋V」→ A + be + p.p. + by B；「…，這讓人有機會…」→ , which gives + 人 + a chance to V。
hints: 切成四段：在創客空間裡，昂貴的設備／由所有會員共用／這讓人人都有機會／把創意變成發明
標的詞彙：expensive（昂貴的）、equipment（設備）、share（共用）、member（會員）、chance（機會）、turn … into（把…變成）、creative（有創意的）、invention（發明）
句型框架：In a makerspace, S + is shared by …, which gives everyone a chance to turn A into B

2.explanation_zh: 主詞「它們」指上一句的創客空間。「開設免費課程」用 offer／run free classes。「讓…也能…」是前面整件事帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 , allowing + 受詞 + to V（也可用 enabling、making it possible for … to V）。「那些買不起工具的人」用 those who cannot afford tools（those who＝那些…的人），「買不起」是 cannot afford。
evidence: 讓那些買不起工具的人
2.strategy_zh: 「…，讓／使得＋人＋V」→ , allowing + 人 + to V；「那些…的人」→ those who + V。
hints: 切成四段：它們還開設免費課程／讓那些買不起工具的人／也能探索興趣／學習新技能
標的詞彙：offer（開設）、free（免費的）、class（課程）、afford（買得起）、tool（工具）、explore（探索）、interest（興趣）、learn（學習）、skill（技能）
句型框架：S + also offer …, allowing those who + V … + to V … and V …

references: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all members, which gives everyone a chance to turn creative ideas into inventions.
In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all the members, which gives everybody an opportunity to turn their creativity into inventions.
In a makerspace, expensive machines and tools are shared by all members, which gives everyone a chance to turn their creative ideas into inventions.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句：which 指前面整句（這讓…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which gives + O + a chance to V …

parts.zh: 在創客空間（makerspace）裡，昂貴的設備
accepted: In a makerspace, expensive machines and tools

common_errors.explanation_zh: equipment（設備）不可數，沒有複數 equipments。
makerspace 是可數名詞，單數要加 a（或用複數 makerspaces）。

accepted: is shared by all the members

common_errors.explanation_zh: 被動式是 be + 過去分詞 shared。

common_errors.wrong: expensive equipment are shared by all members
common_errors.right: expensive equipment is shared by all members
common_errors.explanation_zh: equipment 不可數，be 動詞用單數 is。

common_errors.wrong: members, this gives everyone a chance
common_errors.right: members, which gives everyone a chance
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「這讓…」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which；用 this 會造成逗號連接句。
chance 是可數名詞，單數要加 a。

accepted: to turn creative ideas into inventions
to turn their creativity into inventions
to turn their creative ideas into inventions
to turn their ideas into inventions

common_errors.wrong: to turn creative ideas become inventions
common_errors.right: to turn creative ideas into inventions
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「把 A 變成 B」用 turn A into B，不要再加 become。

common_errors.wrong: to turn creative ideas into invents
common_errors.right: to turn creative ideas into inventions
common_errors.explanation_zh: invent 是動詞，「發明（物）」的名詞是 invention。

traps.literal_error: expensive equipment shares by all members
traps.explanation_zh: 設備是「被」大家共用，英文用被動 is shared by …；equipment 不可數，be 動詞用 is。
「創意」在這裡是名詞（creative ideas／creativity），creative 單獨是形容詞；「把 A 變成 B」用 turn A into B。

bonus.text: Because costly equipment is pooled among members, a makerspace lowers the barrier to invention, letting anyone turn a creative spark into something real.
bonus.explanation_zh: pool（集中共用）、lower the barrier to（降低…的門檻）、a creative spark（創意火花）都是進階搭配；句尾分詞 letting … 表結果。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「由所有會員共用」中文沒有「被」，英文要改成被動 is shared by all members；「這讓人人都有機會…」的「這」指前面整件事，用 , which gives everyone a chance to …。

references: They also offer free classes, allowing those who can't afford their own tools to explore their interests and learn new skills.
They also run free courses, enabling those who cannot afford tools of their own to explore their interests and pick up new skills.
They also provide free lessons, making it possible for those who cannot afford tools to explore their interests and learn new skills.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（讓…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, allowing + O + to V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 讓那些買不起工具的人

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「開設課程」英文說 offer／run classes；open classes 是逐字直譯。
課程不只一堂，用複數 classes。

parts.zh: 讓那些買不起工具的人
accepted: allowing those who can't afford their own tools
allowing those who cannot afford their own tools
allowing those who cannot afford tools
enabling those who cannot afford tools of their own
making it possible for those who cannot afford tools

common_errors.wrong: free classes, let those who cannot afford
common_errors.right: free classes, allowing those who cannot afford
common_errors.explanation_zh: 前面已有完整句子，「讓…」要變成句尾分詞 allowing（表結果），不能在逗號後面直接接原形動詞 let。

common_errors.wrong: allowing those who cannot buy tools
common_errors.right: allowing those who cannot afford tools
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「買不起」是錢不夠，英文用 cannot afford；cannot buy 只是「不能買」，語意不準確。
allow + 受詞 + to + 原形動詞。
「興趣」是名詞 interests，後面不必再加 things。
skill 是可數名詞，「新技能」泛指時用複數 skills。
「學習技能」英文搭配用 learn／pick up；study 多用在學科。

traps.zh: 讓那些買不起工具的人
traps.literal_error: They also offer free classes, let those who cannot afford tools …
traps.explanation_zh: 「讓…」承接前面整句、沒有新主詞，英文不能在逗號後面直接接 let（變成兩個動詞）；用句尾分詞 allowing …，或改成 so that … 子句。
「開設課程」英文說 offer／run／provide classes；open classes 是逐字直譯。

bonus.text: They also run free workshops, opening the door for those who could never afford such tools to discover new passions and skills.
bonus.explanation_zh: opening the door for …（為…打開大門）是比喻用法；could never afford 語氣更強。這是加分寫法。

1.translation: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all the members, which gives everyone a chance to turn their ideas into inventions.
1.explanation_zh: 「由所有會員共用」照中文用被動 is shared by all the members；「這讓人人都有機會」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which gives everyone a chance to；「把創意變成發明」用 turn…into。

2.translation: They also offer free courses, allowing even those who cannot afford tools to explore their interests and learn new skills.
2.explanation_zh: 「開設免費課程」用 offer free courses（也可 classes）；「讓…也能」是結果，用分詞 allowing…to；「那些買不起工具的人」用 those who cannot afford tools；「也」用 even 表示連這些人都能；「探索興趣、學習新技能」兩個原形動詞並列。

1.translation: In makerspaces, expensive equipment is shared by all the members, which gives everyone a chance to turn their ideas into inventions.
1.explanation_zh: 「由所有會員共用」用被動 is shared by；下一句的「它們」指創客空間，所以這裡用複數 makerspaces 較一致；「這讓人人都有機會」用 which gives everyone a chance to ...；「把創意變成發明」用 turn ... into ...。

2.translation: They also offer free classes, which allow people who cannot afford tools to explore their interests and learn new skills, too.
2.explanation_zh: 「它們」指創客空間，用 They；「開設」用 offer；「買不起」用 cannot afford；「讓……也能」用 which allow ... to ..., too；「探索興趣、學習新技能」兩個動詞並列。

issues_zh: 「讓…」我自然寫成 which allow people who cannot afford tools to …（非限定 which 子句），沒有用句尾分詞 allowing；中文不會強迫分詞片語，標的句型 PART 在這句不一定引得出來。
第 2 部分 accepted 只列 allowing／enabling／making it possible for 加 those who，缺少 which allow… 或 so that… 這類同樣正確的寫法；我也是寫 people who 而不是 those who。
